description: Search published Indian Opinion briefs (each one synthesised from several Indian outlets, with a corroboration count and how each outlet framed the story) by keyword, category and date window. Use it to find what we have on a story, person, place or topic. For today's curated list use get_digest; for time-critical alerts use list_breaking. Returns at most 25 items a page with a two-sentence summary each; call get_brief for the full text.

category.description: Section name, for example India, Politics, Business, World, Sports.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call (next_cursor) to get the next page.

limit.description: How many items to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

q.description: Keywords; every word must appear in the title, brief, tags or section. Example: "Bengaluru metro".

since.description: Only briefs published after this ISO 8601 time, for example 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z.

until.description: Only briefs published before this ISO 8601 time.

name: search_briefs
title: Search Indian Opinion briefs
